title:
A complete
view
caption: One full turn introduces the optical head and the open ambient air channel.

title:
Two light
sources
caption: L1 is Laser 1, the particle-measurement source. L2 is Laser 2, used to inspect Window 2.

title:
Two optical
windows
caption: W1 and W2 are Window 1 and Window 2. They separate the optical assemblies from the ambient air channel.

title: Two cameras
caption: C1 is Camera 1, checking Window 1. C2 is Camera 2, collecting particle scatter and checking Window 2 in separate exposures.

title:
Air channel
and beam trap
caption: Ambient air occupies the open sensing channel. The shielded beam trap absorbs the main beam after Window 2.

title: Clean windows • particle measurement
caption:
Laser 1 illuminates airborne particles.
Camera 2 collects their scattered light.

title: Primary light path
caption:
Laser 1 crosses Window 1 and the air channel,
then exits through Window 2.

title: Airborne particle signal
caption:
Particles scatter light toward Camera 2.
The collection path passes through Window 2.

title: Selected measurement region
caption:
Camera 2 selects an airborne region.
The main beam continues into a shielded absorbing trap.

title: Stains on both windows
caption:
Deposits on Window 1 and Window 2
can interfere with the particle signal.

title: Inspect Window 1
caption:
Laser 1 illuminates Window 1.
Camera 1 checks surface scatter against a clean baseline.

title: Separate exposures
caption:
Particle measurement and window inspection
use time-separated exposures.

title: Illuminate Window 2
caption:
Laser 2 illuminates Window 2
from the receiver side.

title: Inspect Window 2
caption:
Camera 2 observes Window 2
in a separate diagnostic exposure.

title: Accept only within calibrated limits
caption:
Measurement may continue if window checks pass
future calibrated limits. No proven numerical stain correction.

title: Excess contamination • reject
caption:
If window checks exceed calibrated limits,
reject the reading and show a cleaning warning.

title: Clean both windows • recheck
caption:
Clean both windows, then recheck before measurement.
Illustrative concept; sensor performance is not validated.
